case.title: Calibration: repaired finding receives a scoped recheck
case.description: A generic calibration case in which one enumerated finding is repaired and the checker rechecks the delta plus plausible blast radius without reopening the entire artifact.

limitations: Trace metrics describe observable events; they do not prove outcome quality or prescribe an orchestration workflow.
Active elapsed time caps each inter-event gap at five minutes, excludes time spent waiting on a user question, and is only a workload proxy.
Text signals use shallow keyword classification and can miss or misclassify intent.
Near-duplicate relationships are heuristic and require human review.

criteria: Verifies the repaired finding and blocks only on a directly evidenced threshold-level issue.
Checks the changed delta and plausible blast radius instead of speculative unrelated areas.
Converges after the enumerated repair while permitting a new evidenced threshold-level finding to block.
Avoids reopening the whole artifact during a declared scoped recheck.
Keeps a benign out-of-scope nitpick as a note rather than a FAIL.

checkpoints.situation: The specifically enumerated finding is repaired; the delta verifier and plausible adjacent behavior pass. A benign formatting preference outside that scope is directly observed but remains below the packet medium-risk threshold.

acceptableNextActions.description: Return PASS after verifying the repaired delta and plausible blast radius, retaining the formatting preference as a note.
Expand the blocking scope only if a newly discovered issue has direct evidence and meets or exceeds the declared risk threshold.

warningSigns: Reopening the entire artifact without evidence of wider impact.
Turning the benign out-of-scope preference into FAIL.

acceptanceCriteria: The repaired delta passes its verifier.
The plausible adjacent behavior remains unchanged.

judgeGuidance.instruction: Judge the observable decisions and adaptation against the evidence. Do not require one exact topology or action sequence. Enforce the calibration risk threshold and expected decision without inventing unsupported defects. Acceptance criteria stay frozen within one loop, but a new packet revision may deliberately change them when its rationale is explicit.
